facts.meaning: pbStartOver first redirects active BugContest to pbBugContestStartOver and returns, before blacked_out_count or STARTING_OVER_SWITCH. Other calls increment count and heal party before choosing return destination. Existing nonnegative PokemonCenter map chooses message/cancelvehicles/Followers.clear, writes game switch at configured index(default1), stages destination, dismounts, optionally transfers only in Scene_Map, refreshes map. Otherwise character home then global home fallback is used. A specified home with absent MapNNN file optionally diagnoses, heals again and returns before switch/escape cleanup. Present home follows same switch/stage/optional-transfer sequence; no home heals again without writing switch. Reached common tail erases escape point.
facts.control: The configured1 is switchID, not a boolean. Count can increase even with no destination or missing-home early return; it measures reached ordinary start-over, not completed transfer. Scene_Map type gate applies only transfer_player, not preceding switch or following refresh. Center branch does not perform the home's explicit file-existence guard.
facts.failure_prefix: Count precedes heal/message/destination. Vehicles/followers can change before switch; switch precedes staged coords/transfer/refresh; any failure preserves prefix and skips later cleanup. Missing-home normal early return also preserves old escape point. No rollback or ensure.
facts.open: Full vehicle/follower/dismount/erase/native-transfer and metadata actual records require separate contributions. No whole blackout domain/native audio/graphics proof or new formal finding.

facts.meaning: pbUpdateSceneMap invokes miniupdate only when scene is Scene_Map and pbIsFaded? false; fade predicate reads game_temp.fadestate>0 or false withouttemp. miniupdate sets in_mini_update=true, updates player/maps/system/screen through transfer loop, then calls updateSpritesets and only afterwards clears flag. updateSpritesets creates missing per-map spritesets, updates/removes map spritesets, updates global spriteset/tint/renderer and finally EventHandlers.trigger(:on_frame_update). Thus a pause/message loop that reaches this helper can dispatch frame consumers despite miniupdate omitting the ordinary map-interpreter update.
facts.control: Ordinary Scene_Map.update also calls updateSpritesets before its later message-window and menu/input gates. Faded helper does no miniupdate here. Transferring/transition flags control loop; there is no promise one miniupdate equals one fixed duration or that every pause loop calls it.
facts.failure_prefix: Any player/map/system/screen/spriteset/render failure can skip later frame dispatch. A frame callback failure can prevent in_mini_update=false, since no ensure. Earlier native/map mutations remain. No universal pause-safe or reentrancy guarantee.
facts.open: All actual pause-loop callers and native Graphics/Input cadence remain separate. These exact units establish possible dispatch path, not every UI pause/scene acceptance.

facts.meaning: EventHandlers.add lazily creates NamedEvent and assigns callback by key; replacing same key changes that slot. trigger uses safe-navigation and passes args to NamedEvent.trigger, whose each_value calls callbacks sequentially without rescue or cancellation test. Missing event is normal nil. NamedEvent add/remove/clear directly mutate its callback hash. BugContest frame callback is named bug_contest_counter under on_frame_update.
facts.control: No thread, priority sort or isolated callback transaction is provided by these methods. One callback's ordinary return does not stop the each_value loop; exception does interrupt later work. Precise live-mutation-during-iteration/native Hash semantics are not newly granted.
facts.failure_prefix: Earlier callback effects persist if later callback raises; no rollback or continue-after-error in this dispatcher. Registration replacement occurs directly and has no per-consumer permission stage.
facts.open: All other current callbacks, installed plugins and actual event dispatch order after source registration remain outside finite named consumer acceptance.

facts.meaning: BugContestState TIME_ALLOWED captures Settings.BUG_CONTEST_TIME=20*60=1200 at class definition. expired? requires inProgress && decision==0, TIME_ALLOWED>0, and current System.uptime-timer_start>=TIME_ALLOWED. pbStart copies current uptime into timer_start before party/contestant selection and count increment, not each frame. clear does not explicitly reset timer_start, but disables progress/decision. Loaded state does not automatically rebase stored uptime to a new process within these methods.
facts.control: Changing Settings afterwards does not alter captured constant. TIME_ALLOWED<=0 suppresses expiration; timer-display creation only excludes exactly0, so negative overrides are not identical to zero in UI. Native uptime monotonicity/cross-process offset are not tested or assumed.
facts.failure_prefix: pbStart sets ballcount/inProgress/otherparty/lastPokemon/lastContest/timer before selection; failure may leave live timer with partial party and no count increment. No save or native clock normalization is requested here.
facts.open: Actual loaded timer migration, process uptime, complete facility compatibility and runtime expiration time remain OPEN beyond source condition.

facts.meaning: Frame bug_contest_counter first evaluates expired?, then returns while any of player.move_route_forcing, pbMapInterpreterRunning?, or temp.message_window_showing. Otherwise requests ANNOUNCER BEEEEEP message, then Time's up message, then pbStartJudging. Interpreter helper returns current game_system map_interpreter&.running?. There is no in_menu condition here and no local in_mini_update exclusion. These three guards postpone judging while uptime still advances externally; they do not reset timer_start.
facts.control: After gates cease and source is still undecided+expired, next reached frame handler can proceed. Other callback failure/scene fade can prevent reaching it. This does not prove eventual delivery or permit assuming every frame callback is safe during a message.
facts.failure_prefix: Message failure can leave expired undecided state; pbStartJudging sets decision1 before pbJudge, so judging failure leaves decision1 suppressing subsequent expired? retries. No ensure/rollback or automatic recovery.
facts.open: Actual message-window flag management, forced-route termination/interpreter completion and all enclosing UI loops remain separately auditable; no native timing execution.

facts.meaning: pbStartJudging sets decision1, computes rankings, then only in Scene_Map enters fade/stages transfer/dismounts/transfers/maprefresh. pbJudge considers player's lastPokemon if any, selects contest-map BugContest or Land encounter table, constructs NPC Pokemon, ranks scores and appends top3; explicit no-map/no-encounter/too-few failures occur before/within this sequence. Existing @places is appended, not cleared by pbJudge itself; pbStart clears it. Quit-menu cancellation refreshes/shows menu and returnsfalse without judging; confirmation ends scene before judging.
facts.control: NonScene_Map still performs decision/ranking and simply skips transfer. Defeat start-over heals/unmega/unprimal each party member before judging. Timeout, quit, battle-zero-balls and defeat reach the same judging method through distinct earlier prefixes.
facts.failure_prefix: decision1 survives rank failure; earlier generated objects/random calls/partial places append survive later failure. Transfer may fail after rankings and staged destination. Confirmed quit can leave menu scene ended even if judging fails; declined quit has only hide/refresh/show effects, no contest state write here.
facts.open: All judging Pokemon formula/encounter record values/ranking native random choices and all UI methods are not accepted merely because full source bodies accompany this finite package.

This visual clamp is distinct from expired? raw elapsed comparison and from three postponement gates. pbEnd restores otherparty before store/ended/wins, then clears active fields and records wallclock lastContest; interrupted path still calls place for wins before clearing, as existing stats contribution already states.
facts.control: Display refresh does not trigger judging itself. Timer can show0 while message/interpreter/forced-route guards defer decision. Sprite timer object receives captured max, independent of later Settings mutation.
